summary: The front door for the conceptual IFC tools, which re-exports the export function, the validator and their result types under one package name.
purpose: Lets other code import the IFC export and validation tools from one place.
why: Likely reason: callers do not need to know the internal file layout of this package.
how: Imports three result types and two functions from the contracts, service and validator modules, then lists them in __all__ to define the public names.
inputs: None at runtime. It only forwards names.
outputs: The names listed in __all__ become available when the package is imported.
risks: If a name is removed from a submodule, importing this package fails, and so does everything that imports it.
debug: If importing schedule3d.bim fails, read the error, which names the submodule that lacks the name. Check that every name in __all__ is also imported above it.
